business_context.suburb_targeting: commercial-activity suburbs prioritised; Pakenham excluded (client: too far)
business_context.competitive_landscape: Melbourne commercial-cleaning SERP contested by national/established cleaners (Clean Group, AMC Commercial Cleaning, ACS) and directories; client-named competitor Whistle Clean Australia (whistlecleanaustralia.com.au). Client DA 0 — fresh entrant; wins come from suburb-level long-tail where incumbents are thin.
business_context.source_counts: Phase 0 ground truth = questionnaire + live-site crawl (fresh client). Site: 8 sitemap pages, 7 nav items. Commercial-cleaning page EXISTS (/commercial-cleaning/); carpet/steam page MISSING; 0 suburb pages. GSC unavailable (client property not in connected account) — quick-wins track disabled. Domestic + end-of-tenancy pages exist but are OUT of keyword scope per BDM brief.

grid_structure.rationale: BDM brief mandates 70% commercial / 30% carpet-steam. score_keywords.py select_location_grid builds a UNIFORM grid (N suburbs x M silos, every suburb gets every silo) which cannot express a non-uniform split. Resolution: run score_keywords --select-locations twice with per-silo-filtered candidate pools and per-silo budgets (commercial=42, carpet=18), then merge. Keeps ONE authoritative commercial page per suburb (office cleaning rides as on-page secondary) to avoid commercial-vs-office suburb-page cannibalisation, and casts the widest geographic net (42 commercial suburbs).
grid_structure.carpet_subset_note: Carpet's 18 suburbs are the top-scoring subset of the 42 commercial suburbs. Phase 1/2 generate carpet candidates across the full approved suburb set so Phase 5 pass-2 can select the best 18.

silos.eligibility_evidence: 42 new suburb pages (no suburb pages exist). Existing generic /commercial-cleaning/ page is a replication template (geo_expansion flavour) but has no GSC ranking proof, so classified category_gap_fill.
silos.volume_evidence: office cleaning melbourne 4,400/mo (LOW); commercial cleaning melbourne 1,900/mo (LOW); commercial cleaning 4,400/mo national; office cleaning 2,900/mo national. Office cleaning captured as on-page secondary, not a separate suburb page, to avoid cannibalisation.

silos.eligibility_evidence: 18 new suburb pages; no carpet/steam page exists anywhere on the site — pure content gap.
silos.volume_evidence: carpet cleaning melbourne 3,600/mo (MED); carpet steam cleaning melbourne 880/mo; steam cleaning melbourne 590/mo. National 'carpet cleaning' 60,500 / 'steam cleaning' 33,100 are DIY/product-contaminated (bissell, vax, steam mop) — suburb-modified service terms are the clean signal.
